# Zeenan | Digital Marketing Expert & Consultant

> Haa Meem Ul Karim Zeenan (goes by Zeenan) is a Digital Marketing Expert & Consultant based in Bangladesh, working with clients across Europe, America, and Asia. NSDA Level 3 certified in Digital Marketing for Freelancing, and holder of a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute.

## About

Zeenan specializes in SEO (Search Engine Optimization), content strategy, keyword research, and social media marketing. The focus is on practical, data-backed strategy rather than generic advice — real keyword research and on-page SEO fundamentals that actually move rankings.

## Services

- SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- Content Strategy & Writing
- Keyword Research
- Social Media Marketing

## Credentials

- NSDA (National Skills Development Authority, Government of Bangladesh) Level 3 Certificate in Digital Marketing for Freelancing
- Professional Digital Marketing Certificate (Grade A+), Creative IT Institute
